env.label: Environment
env.sandboxLead: ky_test_ keys. Deterministic stubs, never billed.
env.liveLead: ky_live_ keys. Real data, debited from organization credit.
env.liveNeedsCredit: A credit balance is required to issue a live key.

home.twoFactor: Two-factor authentication will be required later.
home.keysLead: Prefixes are visible. The secret is shown only at issuance. Sandbox and live are distinct keys.
home.billingLead: Balance, top-ups, and usage for this organization.
home.platformLead: Open a service to configure it, connect an integration, and read its sandbox and live usage.
home.idvCardLead: Verify an identity remotely, from session to decision.
home.biometricLead: Re-compare an enrolled face. The service page is ready; matching is not yet billed.
home.amlLead: Sanctions, PEPs and adverse media. The service page is ready; screening is not yet billed.

product.sessionsEmptySandbox: No sandbox sessions yet. Create one from this console, or with a ky_test_ key.
product.sessionsEmptyLive: No live sessions this month. A ky_live_ key and sufficient credit are required.
product.sessionsLocked: Your role cannot read verification sessions.
product.settingsLead: Rules for this service. They apply to every integration under it.
product.settingsEnvSandbox: You are viewing sandbox. The rules below also apply to live until they are split.
product.settingsEnvLive: You are viewing live. The rules below also apply to sandbox until they are split.
product.settingsIdentityDecisionBody: Automatic approve / decline / review. Custom profiles arrive with the IDV pipeline.
product.settingsIdentityDocumentsBody: Passport, national ID and driving licence in the published corridor. The list will be editable here.
product.settingsIdentityFlowBody: Consent text and expiry. Organization branding of the applicant flow is not in the MVP.
product.settingsBiometrics: Match threshold and enrollment lifetime will be configured here.
product.settingsAml: Sanctions, PEP and adverse-media lists will be configured here.
product.integrationsLead: Each integration is an API entry point (test or live), with its own keys and later its webhooks. It is not the verification queue.
product.integrationsKeysBodySandbox: ky_test_ keys for this service. Free, no credit debit. The secret is shown only at issuance.
product.integrationsKeysBodyLive: ky_live_ keys for this service. Each resource debits organization credit. A sufficient balance is required. The secret is shown only at issuance.
product.integrationsWebhooksBody: Decision callbacks will be signed per integration. Not wired yet.
product.integrationsUnavailable: This service has no API yet. Keys stay under Identity until it ships.
product.billingNotSold: This service does not debit credit yet.

integrations.lead: Create an integration, copy its key, then create verifications from the Verifications tab.
integrations.name: Name
integrations.nameHint: Required and unique in this organization.
integrations.nameTaken: An integration already has this name.
integrations.liveLocked: Live integrations require a credit balance. Card top-up is not wired yet.
integrations.forbidden: Your role cannot create an integration.

install.lead: Create the session on your server, then open the applicant flow with hosted_url. The secret key never leaves your backend.
install.keysLink: The secret key is on the API keys tab.
install.apiBody: POST /v1/verifications with this integration’s Bearer key. The response includes id and hosted_url.
install.openBody: Send the applicant to hosted_url. This is the mode that ships today.
install.incontextBody: The same hosted_url, in an iframe or modal. The JS package is not shipped yet. The iframe does not carry the decision.
install.decisionBody: Fetch the session. Signed webhooks will come later, per integration.

integrations.keysLeadTest: One ky_test_ key per integration, issued on create. The secret is shown only once.
integrations.keysLeadLive: ky_live_ keys for this integration. Each resource debits organization credit. A sufficient balance is required.

verifications.createLead: Optional fields. A hosted link is issued on create.
verifications.pickIntegrationHint: Test integrations never debit credit. Live integrations do.
verifications.noIntegrations: Create an integration first, then you can start a verification.
verifications.applicantHint: Used to find the session in the list.
verifications.externalIdHint: Your internal identifier, unique in this organization.
verifications.scenarioHint: The sandbox stub applies this outcome after capture.
verifications.emptyHint: Create one from this console, or with a ky_test_ key.

billing.lead: Balance, top-ups, and usage for this organization.
billing.balanceHint: Drawn down by live usage. Sandbox does not touch the balance.
billing.liveOpenHint: The balance covers at least one live verification.
billing.liveLockedHint: Top up credit to issue a live key.
billing.topupLead: In the MVP, top-ups are by card. Other channels will come later.
billing.topupPackHint: Credit added to the balance after the card payment.
billing.topupOwner: Stripe Checkout is not wired yet. The button stays inactive until M3.
billing.topupForbidden: Your role cannot top up credit.
billing.consumptionLead: What drew down the credit, per service. This is not an invoice: collection is the balance above.
billing.provisional: Amounts stay provisional until card top-up is connected.

keys.empty: No API keys on this integration.

keys.emptyLive: No live keys (ky_live_) on this integration.

keys.liveLocked: Live keys require a credit balance. Card top-up is not wired yet.
